title: HIGH: review the T1/T2 results, decide the gate, and release Study 09 if closed
forbidden_paths: signed analyses and discussions by other analysts
acceptance_criteria: Each of the six T1/T2 results was reviewed and integrated (or has a recorded reason it could not be)
A signed gate decision states, claim by claim, whether T1 has no remaining single-run headline claim and whether each T2 sweep delivered a five-level verdict

If the gate is closed, the Study 09 hierarchy tasks are released with publish --release in dependency order (harness first) and the program file records the decision; if not, the decision names the exact missing evidence
CONTEXT.md and LESSONS_LEARNED.md updated; merged into local main and tagged
expected_artifacts: released hierarchy tasks or a named shortfall
review_policy: HIGH (independent of the LOW executors); label self-review where the reviewer also authored a reviewed artifact
